Third-party artwork used for the pixel UI trial

Parchment GUI
Author: zwonky
Source: https://opengameart.org/content/parchment-gui
License: CC0 1.0 Universal
License text: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Original downloads:
https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/panels.png
https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/buttons_14.png
Derived from GUI elements: https://opengameart.org/content/gui-elements
Local modifications: extracted plain panel and paper center; replaced the
bright yellow with cream while preserving pixel geometry.

Pixel Art Wooden GUI
Author: Narik / soulofkiran
Author source: https://soulofkiran.itch.io/pixel-art-wooden-gui-v1
Download mirror: https://opengameart.org/content/pixel-art-wooden-gui-by-narik-soulofkiran
License: CC0 1.0 Universal; author also explicitly permits personal and
commercial use, editing, and use without attribution.
License text: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Original download:
https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/wooden_gui_32x32.png
Local modifications: extracted blank brown buttons and wood center.

Rebuild extracted assets with: python tools\prepare_sprites.py
Requires Pillow. Original files are retained in this directory.
UI borders repeat at 2x native pixel scale; they are not stretched across panels.
